A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the zephyr proves it. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. The price of trying is 300 separate visits, each one billed $26 at the door, paid up front for every single name, while the zephyr stays small. The hollow is on the docket. The tally keeps spiral.
